new_root_cause: An absent-before bridge/payload directory cannot be safely removed after restart based on emptiness alone; an unrelated writer can replace it with a different empty directory.

Current backup_files cannot capture NCM28 child snapshots when the nested parent directory is absent, so nested v3 targets require explicit synthetic absent preimages plus parent-guard-bound validation after directory creation.
Old v2 recovery must load the frozen original ten payloads; otherwise a new v3 payload set changes payload_sha256 and strands an interrupted v2 journal.
required_impl_invariants: Journal absent/preexisting state of bridge/payload before mutation.
For absent-before payload dir, create it under NCM28 guard and publish an exact transaction-owner marker as the first durable child; retain marker until phase verified.

Recovery may delete absent-before payload dir only after exact owner marker verification, exact managed-file rollback, exact marker deletion, and guarded empty-directory deletion; missing/drifted marker or foreign child fails closed.
Preexisting payload dir is never removed by rollback.
Nested absent child preimages are synthetic until parent guard exists; child absence/write/delete is then validated under that same guard.
Journal schema dispatch freezes v2 target/payload set and uses v3 exact managed target mapping for new transactions.
